skills.name: contribution-culture
skills.one_line_purpose: Do maintainer toil in small changes, never feature development.
skills.description: Defines the scope and manners of factory work: toil reduction for under-maintained projects in small, reviewable changes, never feature development. Use before deciding how large a change should be or what a task's deliverable is.

skills.name: factory-operations
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep bounded factory work moving until it lands or is externally blocked.
skills.description: Defines continuation, capacity, ownership, and evidence rules for bounded factory work.

skills.name: hive-runtime
skills.one_line_purpose: Operate inside Hive's tmux, token, and cooldown constraints.
skills.description: Explains Hive's tmux session, workspace directory, prompt and output contract, contributor credentials, token lifetime, cooldown, and exclusive task selection. Use when operating or debugging a session.

skills.name: hive-triage
skills.one_line_purpose: Diagnose why an attached contributor is never handed work.
skills.description: Diagnoses a contributor that connects but receives no assignment without adding client-side selection or retry behavior. Use when a ready contributor remains idle.

skills.name: image-build
skills.one_line_purpose: Build and pin the OMP contributor image.
skills.description: Use when maintaining the OMP contributor image, release pins, SBOM inputs, or multi-architecture publication workflows.

skills.name: launcher
skills.one_line_purpose: Change the hive-contribute launcher without breaking its runtime contracts.
skills.description: Maintains the hive-contribute appliance and launcher recipes without crossing credential or authority boundaries.

skills.name: pr-labels
skills.one_line_purpose: Enforce the canonical factory lifecycle, admission, and automation label contract.
skills.description: Defines the repository lifecycle labels, 3-clanker-queue admission, 3-human-queue routing, and the lgtm approval flag. Use when managing labels or triage.

skills.name: pr-workflow
skills.one_line_purpose: Open pull requests that merge cleanly.
skills.description: Defines pull request, branch, title, trailer, and validation requirements, repository lifecycle and queue label taxonomy, how to reconcile a long-lived branch with squash-merged main, and why a test must run a feature.

skills.name: skill-improvement
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep repository documentation source-backed, current, and compact.
skills.description: Maintains repository documentation and skill contracts from current source evidence. Use for repo-wide documentation audits, stale guidance, skill routing, catalog changes, or durable agent learning.

skills.name: upstream-hive
skills.one_line_purpose: File and follow up on hivecommons/hive issues as an exemplary downstream.
skills.description: Defines how this repository reports evidence to hivecommons/hive and follows up on filed issues. Use before opening, commenting on, or responding to an upstream Hive issue or pull request.
